extracted.intended_audience: OpenReview conference organizers / venue administrators (program chairs, sysadmins) who configure venue groups
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for enabling Area Chairs to modify reviewer assignments (both after deployment and for proposed assignments) by adding specific variables to the main conference Group Content in OpenReview.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable Area Chairs to modify reviewer assignments
rubrics_metrics.description: If you would like for Area Chairs to be able to modify reviewer assignments, you can enable this by adding a variable in the Group Content for your venue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable Area Chairs to modify proposed reviewer assignments before deployment
rubrics_metrics.description: If you would like for Area Chairs to be able to modify reviewer assignments before they are deployed, you can enable this by adding a variable in the Group Content for your venue.
